subject: China data regulator: writing standards for embodied AI training datasets

metrics.headline: China data regulator: writing standards for embodied AI training datasets
metrics.body_excerpt: China's data regulator said it will write standards for embodied AI and the datasets that train it. Matters as robots and physical agents become a second front in the US-China compute and data race.
